3aeee9dac0d9b48776b125f19826cfd14e27ae75.pinyin: xì liǔ tíng tíng de lì zài shuǐ biān.

3af00ddbfbaf7b1d197242611751af890b1736cb.pinyin: shì jiè shàng yǒu chāo guò bā shí wàn de bā sī kè yǔ shǐ yòng zhě.
3af00ddbfbaf7b1d197242611751af890b1736cb.text: 世界上有超过八十万的巴斯克语使用者。

3af1821db312e8c872f499b80b62d9bd6b8d011c.pinyin: nà yī shùn jiān, fǎng fú yī qiè dōu tíng zhǐ le.
3af1821db312e8c872f499b80b62d9bd6b8d011c.text: 那一瞬间，仿佛一切都停止了。

3af2df1e7d697d08b48e5d8e40ac4383b164cde2.pinyin: yǐ jīng diū le qián bāo, yòu cuò guò le chē, zhēn shi xuě shàng jiā shuāng.
3af2df1e7d697d08b48e5d8e40ac4383b164cde2.text: 已经丢了钱包，又错过了车，真是雪上加霜。

3af618d3fa00283ab5433f446554218a74f6834d.pinyin: qǐng dān jī yòu shàng jiǎo de àn niǔ.

3afa2afbce1ef63dfb70a4f571311c527a4f608b.pinyin: zhè liàng diàn dòng chē xū yào chōng diàn.

3afe08870d6916e0b8411081516608f75eb2e876.pinyin: gǔ wén yòng piǎo jìn zhǐ è sǐ de rén.
3afe08870d6916e0b8411081516608f75eb2e876.text: 古文用殍殣指饿死的人。
